other_conditions: Applicant must have passed at least standard fourth.
Applicant should have undergone a minimum of three months training from a private establishment or one month from a government‑recognized institute in the proposed business area.
Applicant should have at least one year of experience in the same activity or be a hereditary craftsperson.
Blind or handicapped persons are eligible.
benefits_summary: Provides bank loans up to ₹8 lakh with subsidies up to ₹1.25 lakh for eligible applicants.
